description: Windows Dynamic Island for music playback, synchronized lyrics, audio visualization, water reminders, and plugins.
notes: The publisher provides MyIsland.exe as a standalone Windows 10 1809+ / Windows 11 release; no setup installer is run.
The v1.0.0 SHA-256 matches the GitHub Release asset digest. User data and plugin files are stored under %APPDATA%\MyIsland and remain outside the Scoop app directory.
